properties.notes: Industrial tramway heritage site, not a passenger station or surveyed track alignment. The official register dates the phosphate mining site to 1919–1950 and identifies surviving tramway, ore-storage and loading-wharf remains. Only the register's representative site location is shown; no line geometry is inferred.
